_about: Decided D7 list (operator decision of 2026-09-28, workspace RELEASE-PLAN.md:538; proposal v10, sections 1.5 and 3). Added to the workspace policy's `sandbox_retry_allow`, which may otherwise be empty after a companion pass of spike 0. Each entry still meets the general retry conditions (single simple command, program pinned by absolute path, project cwd, no refused environment, no sandbox-writable PATH entry), and the Herdr subcommand grammar applies to every Herdr call, sandboxed or retried. A registered seat is a live agent that `delegate init` recorded for this task and `herdr agent list` shows; a shell pane never is one. Never allowed: pane run, pane send-text, pane send-keys, agent attach, any agent send-keys form other than the single key Escape, any subcommand not listed. Shell panes and seat approval prompts stay the operator's; a refusal that needs the operator is queued on the operator-actions list.
